title: Theory of Traefik as reverse proxy/load balancer

cues.en: In our current setup, we have our first API application running on port 8000, both in development and in production.
cues.zh: 目前設定中，FastAPI 應用程式在 8000 連接埠執行，開發與正式環境都是如此。

cues.en: We shall want the backend API to be served via traffic.
cues.zh: 我們希望透過 Traefik 提供後端 API。

cues.en: This is where the use of a reverse proxy becomes critical.
cues.zh: 這時反向代理就很重要。

cues.en: The reverse proxy shall be using is called traffic, which is a modern HTTP reverse proxy and load balancer designed for containerized environments.
cues.zh: 我們使用的反向代理叫 Traefik，是為容器化環境設計的現代 HTTP 反向代理與負載平衡器。

cues.en: What exactly is traffic and why do we need it?
cues.zh: Traefik 究竟是什麼？為什麼需要它？

cues.en: When designing highly trafficked and scalable web systems, it is not recommended to have clients send requests directly to the application server.
cues.zh: 設計高流量、可擴展的網頁系統時，不建議讓用戶端直接向應用程式伺服器發送請求。

cues.en: Typically, web content is not served like that.
cues.zh: 網頁內容通常不是這樣提供的。

cues.en: So how is web content served and where does traffic fit in all of this?
cues.zh: 那網頁內容如何提供？Traefik 又在其中扮演什麼角色？

cues.en: In a typical web system architecture, client requests are not sent directly to the application server
cues.zh: 在典型的網頁系統架構中，用戶端請求不會直接送往應用程式伺服器，

cues.en: hosted on cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, DigitalOcean, etc. instead, the requests are first sent to a reverse proxy server, which in our case will be traffic.
cues.zh: 也就是部署在 AWS、GCP、DigitalOcean 等雲端平台上的伺服器。請求會先送到反向代理伺服器，我們使用的就是 Traefik。

cues.en: Traffic will then forward the requests to the appropriate service.
cues.zh: Traefik 再將請求轉送給適當的服務。

cues.en: Then the first API application will process the request and then send the response back to the traffic server, which in turn delivers the content to the client's browser.
cues.zh: FastAPI 應用程式處理請求後，把回應送回 Traefik 伺服器，再由它將內容傳給用戶端瀏覽器。

cues.en: In this situation, traffic acts as a reverse proxy, meaning it receives requests on behalf of your system and automatically discovers which services are responsible for handling those requests by using
cues.zh: 這時 Traefik 作為反向代理，代表系統接收請求，並自動探索負責處理請求的服務。將

cues.en: traffic as a reverse proxy server for our banking API.
cues.zh: Traefik 用作銀行 API 的反向代理伺服器，

cues.en: It will help with one automatic service discovery, where traffic will dynamically discover services in our Docker environments without manual configuration for each service.
cues.zh: 首先能提供自動服務探索：動態找出 Docker 環境中的服務，不必逐一手動設定。

cues.en: Two hostname based routing traffic will route incoming requests to the appropriate service.
cues.zh: 第二，依主機名稱路由，將傳入請求導向適當服務，

cues.en: Based on the rules we shall define, such as the hostname.
cues.zh: 依據就是我們定義的規則，例如主機名稱。

cues.en: Three SSL termination traffic will handle encryption and security by managing SSL certificates and Https connections, especially when you get to production health checks.
cues.zh: 第三，SSL 終止。Traefik 透過管理 SSL 憑證與 HTTPS 連線，處理加密與安全性，正式環境時尤其需要。還有健康檢查，

cues.en: Traffic will monitor the health of our services and stop routing traffic to unhealthy instances.
cues.zh: Traefik 會監控服務的健康狀態，停止將流量導向不健康的執行個體。

cues.en: We shall be configuring a health endpoint with traffic to help us with that.
cues.zh: 我們會搭配 Traefik 設定健康檢查端點，協助完成這件事。

cues.en: While adding an additional layer like traffic might seem like it complicates the design, it serves an important purpose in our banking API architecture.
cues.zh: 增加 Traefik 這一層，可能看起來讓設計更複雜，但它在銀行 API 架構中有重要用途。

cues.en: This is because we shall have multiple services, such as the first API server RabbitMQ or flower MLflow, etc. that will all need to be accessible via different domains.
cues.zh: 因為我們有多個服務，例如 FastAPI 伺服器、RabbitMQ、Flower、MLflow 等，都需要透過不同網域存取。

cues.en: Traffic is going to help us with that.
cues.zh: Traefik 能協助處理。

cues.en: For the banking application we are building, traffic will be used both as a reverse proxy and load balancer.
cues.zh: 在這個銀行應用程式中，Traefik 會同時作為反向代理與負載平衡器。

cues.en: Https encryption will also be introduced during the production build using traffics Letsencrypt integration.
cues.zh: 建置正式環境時，也會透過 Traefik 整合的 Let's Encrypt，加入 HTTPS 加密。

cues.en: That is it for this brief intro to traffic.
cues.zh: Traefik 的簡介就到這裡。
